patient_info.family_history: Father had colon cancer at age 65
patient_info.medical_history: Type 2 diabetes, obesity (BMI 32), no prior cancer history

findings: Circumferential mass in sigmoid colon, 5 cm in length
Bowel wall thickening with luminal narrowing
Multiple enlarged pericolic lymph nodes (largest 1.5 cm)
Liver: 3 hypodense lesions in right lobe (largest 2.8 cm), suspicious for metastases
imaging.impression: Sigmoid colon mass with regional lymphadenopathy and liver metastases, clinical Stage IV

details.T: T3 - Tumor invades through muscularis propria into subserosa
